    Fit Two-Sample Underreported Count Models via JAGS

    urc_two_mcmc.Rd

    Fits Poisson, zero-inflated Poisson (ZIP), and negative binomial (NB) models for two independent underreported count samples using JAGS. Model selection is performed using the Deviance Information Criterion (DIC), Watanabe-Akaike Information Criterion (WAIC), and Pareto-smoothed importance sampling leave-one-out cross-validation (PSIS-LOO). For each criterion, the function applies a parsimony rule that favors the underreported Poisson model when its criterion value is within a specified threshold of the minimum value across the candidate models; otherwise, the model with the minimum criterion value is selected.

    urc_two_mcmc(
  x,
  thresh = 2,
  prior_lambda1 = "dgamma(0.1,0.1)",
  prior_lambda2 = "dgamma(0.1,0.1)",
  prior_p1 = "dbeta(1,1)",
  prior_p2 = "dbeta(1,1)",
  prior_pi1 = "dbeta(1,1)",
  prior_pi2 = "dbeta(1,1)",
  prior_c1 = "dgamma(0.1,0.1)",
  prior_c2 = "dgamma(0.1,0.1)",
  n_iter = 8000,
  n_chains = 2,
  n_burnin = 4000,
  inits = NULL,
  seed = 123,
  parallel = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    x

    A named list containing the data for JAGS models. Must include: yobs1, yobs2 (observed counts subject to underreporting), ystar1, ystar2 (true counts for validation), yval1, yval2 (validation observed counts)

    thresh

    Numeric. The threshold used for the parsimony rule. If the underreported Poisson model is within thresh units of the minimum value of a model-selection criterion, the Poisson model is selected as the preferred model; otherwise, the model with the minimum value of the criterion is selected. Applied separately to DIC, WAIC, and PSIS-LOO. Default is 2.

    prior_lambda1

    Prior for lambda (sample 1, Poisson/NB)

    prior_lambda2

    Prior for lambda (sample 2, Poisson/NB)

    prior_p1

    Prior for reporting probability (sample 1)

    prior_p2

    Prior for reporting probability (sample 2)

    prior_pi1

    Prior for zero-inflation probability (sample 1, ZIP only)

    prior_pi2

    Prior for zero-inflation probability (sample 2, ZIP only)

    prior_c1

    Prior for NB dispersion (sample 1, NB only)

    prior_c2

    Prior for NB dispersion (sample 2, NB only)

    n_iter

    Total number of MCMC iterations per chain.

    n_chains

    Number of MCMC chains.

    n_burnin

    Number of burn-in iterations.

    inits

    Optional initial values (function or list).

    seed

    Random seed for reproducibility.

    parallel

    Logical. If TRUE, model fitting is performed in parallel using the future and furrr frameworks. This enables simultaneous fitting of the Poisson, zero-inflated Poisson, and negative binomial models across multiple workers. If FALSE, the models are fitted sequentially.

    Value

    A named list containing:

    models

    A named list of fitted rjags model objects.

    dics

    A data frame containing the DIC value for each fitted model.

    waics

    A data frame containing the WAIC value for each fitted model.

    loos

    A data frame containing the PSIS-LOO value for each fitted model.

    dic_best

    The preferred model selected using the DIC-based parsimony rule.

    waic_best

    The preferred model selected using the WAIC-based parsimony rule.

    loo_best

    The preferred model selected using the PSIS-LOO-based parsimony rule.
